name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: Edge-anchored modal drawer sliding from top, right, bottom or left, built on ui-sdk Dialog.
docs: Bind with v-model:open and pick an edge with side (top, right, bottom or left). Always render SheetTitle inside SheetContent so screen readers announce the drawer. Set hideClose when supplying a custom dismiss button.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Dialog as DialogRoot } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'
import { provideDialogBehaviour } from '../dialog/behaviour'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SheetProps = {
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SheetProps>(), {
  defaultOpen: undefined,
})

const open = defineModel<boolean | undefined>('open', { default: undefined })
const onOpenChange = provideDialogBehaviour()
</script>

<template>
  <DialogRoot
    v-model:open="open"
    :default-open="defaultOpen"
    modal
    v-bind="$attrs"
    @open-change="onOpenChange"
  >
    <slot />
  </DialogRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { DialogTrigger as SdkDialogTrigger } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SheetTriggerProps = {
  as?: string | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SheetTriggerProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkDialogTrigger v-bind="$attrs" :class="!asChild && 'h-auto border-0 bg-transparent p-0'">
    <template #render="{ props: part }">
      <RenderChild v-if="asChild" v-bind="part"><slot /></RenderChild>
      <component :is="as" v-else v-bind="part"><slot /></component>
    </template>
  </SdkDialogTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { DialogClose as SdkDialogClose } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SheetCloseProps = {
  as?: string | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SheetCloseProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkDialogClose v-bind="$attrs" :class="!asChild && 'h-auto border-0 bg-transparent p-0'">
    <template #render="{ props: part }">
      <RenderChild v-if="asChild" v-bind="part"><slot /></RenderChild>
      <component :is="as" v-else v-bind="part"><slot /></component>
    </template>
  </SdkDialogClose>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { DialogTitle as SdkDialogTitle } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkDialogTitle
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('text-[17px] leading-snug font-semibold text-ink', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkDialogTitle>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { DialogDescription as SdkDialogDescription } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkDialogDescription
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-ink-muted', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkDialogDescription>
</template>

export { default as Sheet } from './Sheet.vue'
export { default as SheetTrigger } from './SheetTrigger.vue'
export { default as SheetClose } from './SheetClose.vue'
export { default as SheetContent } from './SheetContent.vue'
export { default as SheetHeader } from './SheetHeader.vue'
export { default as SheetFooter } from './SheetFooter.vue'
export { default as SheetTitle } from './SheetTitle.vue'
export { default as SheetDescription } from './SheetDescription.vue'
export { sheetVariants } from './variants'

export type { SheetSide } from './variants'
export type { SheetProps } from './Sheet.vue'
export type { SheetTriggerProps } from './SheetTrigger.vue'
export type { SheetCloseProps } from './SheetClose.vue'
export type { SheetContentProps } from './SheetContent.vue'
